name: globalise-voc-transcriptions
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for accessing a corpus of c. 4.8M machine-generated transcriptions of 17-18th century Dutch East India Company (VOC) records hosted by the GLOBALISE project at the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW).
long_description:
**Features:**  
• Search the full text of c. 4.78 million machine-transcribed pages from the *OBP* for a word or phrase, narrow the results by inventory number or language, and combine terms with boolean operators, wildcards, and fuzzy matching to catch historical spellings.  
• Retrieve any page by its identifier to read the complete transcription line by line, together with its languages, dates, rights statement, and links to the original scan at the Dutch National Archives.  
• Move page by page through an inventory to follow a volume in sequence instead of jumping between scattered search results.  
• Search more than 228,000 *TANAP* finding-aid entries — the catalogue layer above the transcriptions — to locate the right inventories before reading any pages, and to reach the published scholarly edition of the *Generale Missiven* in the RGP series at the Huygens Institute.  
• Look up a VOC trade good or a historical unit of weight, volume, length, or area to find the period term to search for, its spelling variants, a sourced definition, and any recorded conversion ratios.  
• View a page scan beside its line-numbered transcription in an interactive viewer, and ask the AI assistant to zoom in on a detail or examine the image for you.

tools.name: globalise_search_transcriptions
tools.description: Full-text search across ~4.8M transcribed VOC pages, with inventory and language filters and aggregations.

tools.name: globalise_retrieve_document
tools.description: Retrieve one page by document ID or URN: full transcription, metadata, and prev/next page links.

tools.name: globalise_navigate
tools.description: Fetch the previous or next page relative to a document ID, for sequential reading.

tools.name: globalise_find_archival_documents
tools.description: Query a local index of 228K+ VOC finding-aid descriptions (OBP indexes + Generale Missiven). Downloaded once on first use, then cached on-device.

tools.name: globalise_view_document_ui
tools.description: Open an interactive viewer (IIIF scan image plus transcription, side-by-side) as an MCP App.

tools.name: globalise_inspect_page_image
tools.description: Fetch a page scan or a region of it as an image the assistant can read directly (base64 crop via IIIF).

tools.name: globalise_navigate_viewer
tools.description: Zoom/pan an open viewer to a region (needs the viewUUID from globalise_view_document_ui).

tools.name: globalise_poll_viewer_commands
tools.description: Internal: the viewer iframe's command-polling channel (app-only, hidden from the agent tool list).

tools.name: globalise_lookup_commodity
tools.description: Look up VOC trade goods in the bundled commodities thesaurus (3,508 concepts): bilingual NL/EN labels, period spelling variants, and a sourced definition.

tools.name: globalise_lookup_measure
tools.description: Look up VOC weights & measures in the bundled glossary (213 units): type, period spelling variants, definitions, and period-reported conversion ratios.

data_directory.title: Data directory
data_directory.description: Writable folder where the downloaded index is cached. Created if it does not exist.

debug_logging.title: Debug logging
debug_logging.description: Write per-tool diagnostic lines (including the download progress) to the server's stderr log.

structured_content.title: Send structured tool output
structured_content.description: Include machine-readable structuredContent alongside text results. Keep enabled for Claude Desktop; disable only for hosts that reject structured output.
